description: Quarterly results (EPS and revenue as reported, plus a guidance note when stated) that Nexqual captured from companies' SEC 8-K filings and earnings press releases the moment they were published. Each figure was confirmed by two independent extraction methods. Covers US companies of roughly $10B+ market value from late September 2026 onward. Reported actuals only: no analyst estimates.

symbol.description: Optional US ticker, e.g. JPM. Omit for the most recent results across all companies.

name: get_earnings_results
title: Reported earnings results (8-K / press release)
